purpose: Teach: 駆ら/向かわ/住環境/引き取っ/鉄筋コンクリート/取り外し/同乗/拝聴

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人を熱意に駆られた研修に送れ
lines.en: Send our new hires to a training program driven by real enthusiasm.
lines.style: Clipped, low-pitched command with no preamble. Even weight on every word, expecting immediate action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外向かわせる出張者の選定を進めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll move ahead on selecting who we send overseas.
lines.style: Prompt, crisp acknowledgment, then a steady businesslike pace, professionally flat but attentive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の住環境改善を支援しろ
lines.en: See that the company supports improving our employees' living conditions.
lines.style: Measured directive, slight downward finality on the last word, brooking no discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。退職者の業務を引き取って整えます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll take over the departing staff's duties and get them in order.
lines.style: Quick affirmative, then an efficient rundown tone, a faint tiredness under the professionalism.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本社ビルを鉄筋コンクリート構造で建て直せ
lines.en: Rebuild the headquarters building as a reinforced concrete structure.
lines.style: Weighty, deliberate delivery, slowing over the technical term, the decision already made.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い看板の取り外し工事を依頼します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll commission the work to take down the old signage.
lines.style: Brisk note-taking cadence, confirming each detail cleanly, a slight lift signaling readiness for more.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社用車の同乗ルールを整えろ
lines.en: Put proper rules in place for riding together in company vehicles.
lines.style: Short, dry command, almost offhand in tone but precise, eyes already on the next item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。専門家のご講演を拝聴します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll be there to hear the expert's lecture, respectfully.
lines.style: Polished closing acknowledgment, a respectful softening on the humble phrase, the quiet exhale of a meeting ending.
